about: Problems found outside recorded test runs: by lint, by a pipeline check on real data, by reading, in the browser pane, or by Marcus. Taken from progress/log.md and the phase specs. Each entry names the evidence file; web/src/claims.test.jsx checks every field is filled and every evidence file exists.

entries.what: Three lines of code were damaged by the shell tool: double backslashes collapsed to one.
entries.how: oxlint failed on the damaged lines.
entries.fix: Rewrote the lines without backslashes; added a rule to CLAUDE.md.

entries.foundBy: Pipeline check C2 on the real transcripts
entries.what: One API request at 00:13:13 EST had no response (a retry), so the completeness check failed.
entries.how: The first real run of build.py.
entries.fix: C2 now lists unanswered retries as known gaps (shown on the Token usage tab) instead of ignoring them.

entries.foundBy: Pipeline check C1 on the real transcripts
entries.what: Claude typed a usage reading's time from memory (09:55 instead of 09:52). After that was fixed, C1 still failed because the reading fell between two responses.
entries.how: C1 compares each reading's context with the transcript's responses around that time.
entries.fix: Time corrected; C1 changed to a between-two-responses rule; CLAUDE.md now requires times from date -Iseconds.
entries.guard: Pipeline test test_context_check_needs_the_reading_between_two_consecutive_responses_in_time; the CLAUDE.md timestamp rule.

entries.foundBy: Claude (reading the IPEDS data before the draw)
entries.what: The planned frame (CIP 11.0701 only) would have left out Ohio State and Cincinnati.
entries.how: Checked the two fixed Ohio schools against the frame before drawing.
entries.guard: None automated; the frame rule and counts are in data/frame/SOURCES.md.

entries.what: Ctrl+F on the saved copy could not find the MIT software engineering quote: the saved HTML had <em> tags inside the sentence.
entries.how: Marcus followed the checklist step to find a quote by hand.
entries.fix: The checklist step now points at the live page; Phase 3 added links that open the live page with the quote highlighted.
entries.guard: Web test: a text fragment matches the whole quote (never first,last words), escapes dashes, skips PDFs.

entries.foundBy: Claude (reading build output at Phase 3 start)
entries.what: Seven usage readings had 5 columns instead of 7, so the pipeline read every value one column off and nothing failed.
entries.how: The phases in the build output had names like "66".
entries.fix: Rows repaired; build.py now stops on a malformed row.

entries.what: A quote link built from the first and last words highlighted the wrong passage on MIT's page, because an earlier sentence starts the same way.
entries.how: Opened the link in the browser pane.
entries.guard: Web test: a text fragment matches the whole quote (never first,last words), escapes dashes, skips PDFs.

entries.what: The study check table showed FAIL for checks that do not apply to a school (for example quote checks for a school with no quotes).
entries.guard: Web test: the study check table has all 15 schools, each cell matching checks.json.

entries.what: Three Phase 3 test runs were recorded as Phase 2, because STATE.md still named Phase 2 when they ran.
entries.how: The phase filter put them in the wrong phase.
entries.fix: Their phase was corrected, with a correction note kept in each file; STATE.md is now updated before any run is recorded.
entries.guard: None automated; the order is written into STATE.md's first steps.

entries.what: The run list said "Nothing is left out", but runs on GitHub before each deploy and test commands run without the recorder were never recorded.
entries.how: Read every sentence on the site against its evidence.
entries.fix: The sentence now says what the list holds and gives the pipeline's count of unrecorded test commands.

entries.what: The Research note said "5 in Ohio" without saying that two were chosen by Marcus, and the Token usage summary promised a "new session" comparison the page does not have.
entries.how: Read every sentence on the site against its evidence.
entries.fix: The note gives the chosen and random counts from sample.csv; the summary names only /clear and /compact.
entries.guard: Web test: the Research note counts the Ohio schools Marcus chose from sample.csv; the claims tests.

entries.what: The Errors caught note said each mutation was followed by a passing run ("the next run passes"). On Nov 8 the first web mutation was followed by a second mutation, and only then a passing run.
entries.how: Listed the run after each failing run.
entries.fix: Reworded to: each mutation is followed by a passing run of the same suite once the planted bug is removed.
entries.guard: Pipeline check C6 and its test test_each_mutation_needs_to_fail_and_a_later_passing_run_of_its_suite.

entries.what: The shell tool collapsed backslashes again while writing the pipeline's test-command rule, which would have broken its patterns.
entries.how: Printed the written lines before running anything.
entries.fix: Rewrote the two lines through a script that builds backslashes with chr(92).

entries.foundBy: A recorded test run (Claude's design error)
entries.what: The new web test for mutation follow-ups failed the clean run it was part of: a test cannot see the run it belongs to, so the newest mutation always looked unanswered.
entries.how: The clean run after both Phase 4 mutations failed that one test (48 of 49 passed).
entries.fix: The check moved to the pipeline as C6, which runs after the runs are recorded (the same reason C5 lives there). The failed run is kept with a correction note.
entries.guard: Pipeline check C6 and its test test_each_mutation_needs_to_fail_and_a_later_passing_run_of_its_suite.

entries.foundBy: Pipeline check C3 on the real transcripts
entries.what: Marcus's /compact at 12:45 came right after a tool call he stopped. The tool's rejection and the interrupt note were in the context but never answered, so the tokens before the /compact were 508 more than the last response accounted for, and C3 (an exact match) failed.
entries.fix: C3 now allows a larger count only when unanswered records follow the last response, and lists the difference and their times; every other /compact must still match exactly.
